description: Build every remaining sidebar destination as a real console-styled page: a full custom Dashboard, a full Health checks page, and all 14 mocked pages via ConsoleListPage (including rewriting the existing Profiles and Traffic policies pages that currently use ComingSoon). Depends on FEAT-001 (ConsoleListPage, icons, .dash-* and .banner classes, .btn--outline-blue). Does NOT yet delete ComingSoon.tsx or the /coming-soon and /resolver routes — that is FEAT-004. All titles/columns/placeholders/empty-state copy come VERBATIM from design.md 'Per-page table spec' and the FR-5/FR-6 descriptions.
steps: Rewrite c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\dashboard\page.tsx (remove ComingSoon) as a full custom Dashboard: Breadcrumb [{label:'Route 53',href:'/hosted-zones'},{label:'Dashboard'}]; title 'Route 53 Dashboard' + blue Info (InfoLink); a .dash-grid 2x2 of .dash-card — DNS management (with a 'Create hosted zone' .btn--outline-blue Link to /hosted-zones/create), Availability monitoring ('Create health check'), Traffic management ('Create policy'), Domain registration (with a red 'Error'); a 'Register domain' card; a 'Notifications' card (refresh, search, pager, Resource/Status columns, empty 'No notifications to display'); a 'More resources' card (trailing arrow); a 'Service health' card. All static; links href='#' except the hosted-zone create link. No placeholder/Coming soon text.

Rewrite c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\health-checks\page.tsx (remove ComingSoon) as a full Health checks page: Breadcrumb [{label:'Route 53',href:'/hosted-zones'},{label:'Health checks'}]; title 'Health checks (0)' + blue Info; right circular refresh + outlined-orange 'Create health check'; a subtext line about monitoring; a 'Find health check' filter; the real Pagination (total 0) + gear; columns (checkbox) ID, Name, State, Details, Status in last 24 hours, Actions; empty state centered 'No health checks to display.' + a 'Create health check' button. Static/mocked. May be built directly with ConsoleListPage if the checkbox column and action fit; otherwise custom.

Rewrite c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\profiles\page.tsx and c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\traffic-policies\page.tsx (remove ComingSoon) as thin ConsoleListPage configs per the Per-page table spec. Profiles: title 'Profiles (0)', filter 'Find profiles', columns Name, ID, Status, Created. Traffic policies: title 'Traffic policies (0)', filter 'Find traffic policies', columns Name, ID, Type, Records, Version, plus a visual-only outlined-orange action 'Create traffic policy'.

Create the new ConsoleListPage pages (each page.tsx under frontend/src/app) using the Per-page table spec, with breadcrumb 'Route 53 > {Title}' and empty-state heading 'No {lowercased title}' / subtext 'There are no {lowercased title} to display.': global-resolvers (Global resolvers (0), 'Find global resolvers', cols Name/ID/Status/Region/Created); shared-dns-views (Shared DNS views (0), 'Find shared DNS views', cols Name/ID/Owner/Status/Created); vpcs (VPCs (0), 'Find VPCs', cols VPC ID/Name/Region); inbound-endpoints (Inbound endpoints (0), 'Find inbound endpoints', cols ID/Name/VPC/Status); outbound-endpoints (Outbound endpoints (0), 'Find outbound endpoints', cols ID/Name/VPC/Status); rules (Rules (0), 'Find rules', cols Name/ID/Type/Domain); query-logging (Query logging (0), 'Find query logging configurations', cols ID/Hosted zone/Destination); outposts (Outposts (0), 'Find Outposts', cols ID/Name/Status); requests (Requests (0), 'Find requests', cols Request ID/Domain name/Operation/Status/Last updated); cidr-collections (CIDR collections (0), 'Find CIDR collections', cols Name/ID/CIDR blocks); policy-records (Policy records (0), 'Find policy records', cols Name/Policy/Version/DNS name, plus visual-only outlined-orange 'Create policy record').

Create c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\registered-domains\page.tsx via ConsoleListPage: title 'Registered domains (0)', filter 'Find domains', columns Domain name/Expiration date/Auto-renew, empty-state 'No registered domains' / 'There are no registered domains to display.', a banner prop with an unconditional red .banner.banner--error containing EXACT text 'You don't have permission to view registered domains. Contact your administrator.', and visual-only secondary header actions 'Register domain', 'Transfer', 'Transfer out'.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in frontend exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
/dashboard and /health-checks render the full specified layouts with no 'Coming soon' text.

Every mocked sidebar destination (profiles, traffic-policies, global-resolvers, shared-dns-views, vpcs, inbound-endpoints, outbound-endpoints, rules, query-logging, outposts, registered-domains, requests, cidr-collections, policy-records) resolves to a built console-styled page whose title, (0) count, filter placeholder, and ordered column labels match the Per-page table spec.
Registered domains renders the unconditional red access-denied banner with the pinned text.
verification: Browser (admin/admin): click every sidebar item and confirm each page renders the correct title/columns/empty state; Dashboard and Health checks match FR-5/FR-6; Registered domains shows the red banner.
findings:
DONE. `npm run build` exits 0 (TypeScript clean). All 24 routes present including the 11 new ConsoleListPage routes + registered-domains; /coming-soon and /resolver intentionally still exist (FEAT-004 deletes them); ComingSoon.tsx not deleted (FEAT-004).

Dashboard (app/dashboard/page.tsx): full custom page, no ComingSoon. Breadcrumb Route 53(/hosted-zones) > Dashboard; h1 'Route 53 Dashboard' + <InfoLink/>; .dash-grid 2x2 of .dash-card (DNS management -> btn btn--outline-blue Link to /hosted-zones/create; Availability monitoring -> 'Create health check'; Traffic management -> 'Create policy'; Domain registration -> bold red 'Error'); then standalone .dash-card 'Register domain'; a 'Notifications' .dash-card with .toolbar (search + refresh icon-btn + real Pagination total=0 + gear) and a Resource/Status data-table whose empty state is 'No notifications to display'; a 'More resources ↗' .dash-card with .resource-list; a 'Service health' .dash-card. All links href='#' except the hosted-zone create Link.

Health checks (app/health-checks/page.tsx): full custom (NOT ConsoleListPage, because of the leading checkbox column + colSpan). Breadcrumb Route 53 > Health checks; h1 'Health checks (0)' + InfoLink; right: circular refresh .icon-btn + outlined-orange 'Create health check' (btn btn--create); .helper-line subtext; .toolbar with 'Find health check' search + Pagination total=0 + gear; data-table head: checkbox-cell th + ID, Name, State, Details, Status in last 24 hours, Actions; empty state centered 'No health checks to display.' + a btn btn--create 'Create health check'.

Profiles & Traffic policies rewritten as thin ConsoleListPage configs (ComingSoon removed). Profiles: title 'Profiles' count 0, filter 'Find profiles', cols Name/ID/Status/Created. Traffic policies: title 'Traffic policies' count 0, filter 'Find traffic policies', cols Name/ID/Type/Records/Version, outlined-orange action 'Create traffic policy'.

New ConsoleListPage pages (all count=0, info, breadcrumb 'Route 53 > {Title}', empty 'No {lower title}' / 'There are no {lower title} to display.'): global-resolvers, shared-dns-views, vpcs, inbound-endpoints, outbound-endpoints, rules, query-logging, outposts, requests, cidr-collections, policy-records (policy-records has outlined-orange 'Create policy record'). Columns & filter placeholders match the Per-page table spec verbatim.

registered-domains: ConsoleListPage with banner prop = <div className="banner banner--error" role="alert"> containing EXACT pinned text (apostrophe via '): "You don't have permission to view registered domains. Contact your administrator."; secondary actions Register domain / Transfer / Transfer out (visual-only); cols Domain name/Expiration date/Auto-renew; empty 'No registered domains'.

Notes for later features: ConsoleListPage emptyText is a single string (no newline), empty state renders inside the table body via colSpan. --color-error-text is NOT a defined token; the Dashboard 'Error' uses inline style color: var(--color-error-text, #d13212) fallback. ConsoleListPage renders secondary actions as <Link href="#"> when no onClick (fine for visual-only). Lowercased empty-state copy keeps acronyms lowercased per the spec's literal formula (e.g. 'No vpcs', 'No cidr collections', 'No query logging') — matches design.md's stated formula.
